;;;68     
;;;69     uint8_t TMC5130_WriteRegister(uint8_t address, int32_t data)

;;;80

                  |L27.48|

;;;83             buffer[i] = TMC_SPI_Byte_Write(buffer[i]);

;;;87         
;;;88         Delay(5);

;;;89     		
;;;90     	return buffer[0];
